usageNotes: Regenerates the cloud-init config drive ISO in-place for the specified VM; use this after changing any cloud-init parameters (user, network, meta) via the VM config endpoints so the drive reflects the current settings. The VM does not need to be running — the drive is rebuilt from the stored config — but the updated data is only applied on the next VM boot. Requires the VM.Config.Cloudinit privilege on /vms/{vmid}; returns null synchronously (no UPID), so no task polling is needed.

examples.summary: Regenerate the cloud-init drive on VM 201 after updating its network config

tips: This call is a no-op if the VM has no cloud-init drive attached — attach one via the disk config first.
Returns null (not a UPID), so the operation completes synchronously; no need to poll task status.
Cloud-init data is applied at boot time, not immediately — reboot the VM after regenerating to activate the new config.
If you updated cloud-init settings via the QEMU config PUT endpoint, always follow up with this call to keep the drive in sync.
